description: This file contains shell functions related to managing boot configuration partitions and switching active root filesystems on Qualcomm-based embedded devices. It includes functions for reading, updating, and swapping boot partition entries, as well as preparing upgrade procedures.

methods.name: bootconfig_rw_index
methods.description: Reads or updates the boot configuration index for a specified partition and entry.

methods.name: tcl_swap_active_root
methods.description: Switches the active root filesystem by updating boot configuration entries.

methods.name: tcl_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade by setting boot parameters and swapping root if necessary.
